svg.title: Figure 8. Cascade sizes
svg.desc: Figure 8. Log-log plot of the share of structural cascades at least a given size, for the primary pooling of one run per removal order (229 positive sizes) and the sensitivity pooling with all 30 random trials (342 positive sizes), each with its fitted discrete power law. Primary: exponent 2.011 above size 8, bootstrap p = 0.202, plausible. Sensitivity: exponent 1.872 above size 4, bootstrap p = 0.036, rejected. Against a lognormal the likelihood ratio is not significant in either pooling (p = 0.314 and 0.752). The largest cascade is 6,046 types.
